ruling.recommended_action: Send to a human reviewer: assess driver conduct under the Code of Conduct (abuse/intimidation) and RydeHELP reporting; leave the $6.61 fee undisturbed on the NS-1 record unless the reviewer finds a stricter 'at the pick-up location' standard under the unpublished radius (G2); surface the driver's 2 upheld no-show disputes in 90 days (F18) for a separate no-show-pattern account review — no automatic account action attaches under RD-6.
ruling.escalation_reason: safety concern confirmed (F11, F12); evidence gap: None material: chat record complete and timestamped (F12), GPS/timeline consistent (F2, F5, F6). The only open point is whether a 42 m stationary position satisfies "at the pick-up location" under NS-1(ii) — Ryde has published no radius (G2).

rejected_claims.reason: Not rejected on substance — the threat reading is accepted (F11, F12, SAFE-1); the claim's escalation consequence is granted, not denied.

The record settles the timing the other way: tap at 09:50:45 with 220 s continuously inside 200 m afterwards (F6), 4 min 20 s within 200 m (F2), 4 min 0 s stationary (F3), cancellation 4 min 20 s after recorded arrival (F5 F4) — NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are met, so no refund under NS-1/NS-2.
The conduct and the fee are separate questions; the SAFE-1 escalation (F11) does not itself establish that the NS-1 fee was unlawful.
Cancellation was a driver no-show cancel with all NS-1 elements satisfied (F4, F6, F5); NS-3 therefore does not apply and the fee is not refundable on this record.
RD-6 is conditioned on a route dispute; the driver's profile shows route disputes 0, no-show disputes 2 (F18), so RD-6 does not attach here.
Withdrawn by the driver as to resistance to account review; the profile counts (F18) support a no-show pattern but are not a route-dispute basis and cannot decide the fee either way.
